in_marathi.name: Ganga
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Ganges River
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The Ganga river is considered sacred in Hinduism. The goddess Ganga is the embodiment of the river and is revered for her purifying powers.
